player_prompt.intro:
A yi walla 2048 caggal {board_size}x{board_size} caggal. Makko wadii mawɗo maa e wuudu {target_tile} tile caggal ɓoggol ɗuuɗe ɓurɗe e kooɓe!
Koɗe ɓoggol: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tile'en ɓoggol so aɓɓe ɓaawo aɓɓe, ɓoggol maɓɓe ɓurɗe.

outcome.win: Mubarak, a yi wuudu {target_tile}! Ciŋkoo koli {score}.
outcome.lose: Babu sauye-sauye da aka rage. Tile mafi girma {max_tile} - mafi ƙarshe cifka {score}.
